name: Roppongi
tagline: Roppongi in 1 minute and Toranomon in 5 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 10 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. The station stands 31.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 31.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 14.9 m to 31.4 m, a difference of 16.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 明治屋 六本木ストアー

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 心臓血管研究所付属病院, about 11 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 順和会山王病院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line and Toei Oedo Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 三ノ輪→入谷, which this station is not on. Toei Oedo Line runs at 147%. Its busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥580,000 to ¥590,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the highest in the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and plenty of places to eat out pushes the figure up. On the other side, many bars by the station and voices outside late at night holds it down. For 1K, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Nogizaka, but Roppongi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Roppongi. Nogizaka has only the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, so Roppongi is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Nogizaka takes 16 minutes longer. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥17,000 less at Nogizaka.

neighbours.lead: Roppongi-Itchome is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Roppongi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Roppongi. Roppongi-Itchome has only the Tokyo Metro Namboku Line, so Roppongi is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Roppongi-Itchome takes 9 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥9,000 more at Roppongi-Itchome. On the number of medical facilities, though, Roppongi-Itchome comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
外苑東通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are some of the most heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
